SELECT s.id AS id, s.activity_id AS activityId, COALESCE(a.title, '') AS activityTitle, COALESCE(a.activity_date, '') AS activityDate, COALESCE(a.time_slot, '') AS activityTime, COALESCE(a.place, '') AS activityPlace, COALESCE(ar.name, '') AS areaName, COALESCE(u.real_name, '') AS realName, COALESCE(u.nickname, '') AS nickname, COALESCE(u.mobile, '') AS parentMobile, s.student_id AS studentId, COALESCE(st.name, '') AS studentName, CAST(s.status AS SIGNED) AS status, COALESCE(s.order_id, 0) AS orderId, COALESCE(o.sn, '') AS orderSn, o.order_amount AS orderAmount, CAST(o.pay_status AS SIGNED) AS payStatus, CAST(o.pay_way AS SIGNED) AS payWay, CAST(o.refund_status AS SIGNED) AS refundStatus, o.pay_time AS payTime, s.create_time AS createTime
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(s.activity_id, '|', s.student_id)) AS uniqueCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.pay_status = 1 THEN CONCAT(s.activity_id, '|', s.student_id) END) AS paidCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.order_id IS NULL OR s.order_id = 0 OR o.id IS NULL THEN CONCAT(s.activity_id, '|', s.student_id) END) AS freeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_status = 0 THEN CONCAT(s.activity_id, '|', s.student_id) END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_status = 4 THEN CONCAT(s.activity_id, '|', s.student_id) END) AS cancelledCount

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.order_amount), 0), 2) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS id, o.order_amount AS order_amount
AND o.pay_status = 1 ) t
